source_title: One Piece Officially Announces Setup for Luffy's Gear 6
source_excerpt:
One Piece is currently in the climax of the Elbaf arc, where the Strawhat Pirates are fighting the biggest battles of their lifetime as the threat of Nerona Imu and the World Government attempts to engulf the giant country. The recent chapters of One Piece , including One Piece Chapter 1197, have thrown a ton of focus on Luffy's wings, Zoro, and Sanji.
In One Piece Chapter 1194, released officially on September 28, 2026, in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 44, Roronoa Zoro was given his Elbaf arc power-up in the form of the Color of the Supreme King. In One Piece Chapter 1197, which is set to be released on November 1, Sanji is getting his own Conqueror's Haki power-up. With both Zoro and Sanji now having received their ultimate power-ups, it is time for Monkey D. Luffy to tap into his next power-up as well, which is, more likely than not, going to be Gear 6.
One Piece's New Zoro And Sanji Power Ups Confirm Set Up Luffy's Gear 6
One Piece's Straw Hat Pirates have grown in a multitude of ways in the Elbaf arc, and over half of the crew has received a tremendous upgrade in one form or another. When it comes to those who have received small power-ups, we have Franky and Chopper. In the case of Franky, he was given a new power-up with the reveal of Omni Drain Converters in chapter 1176 , officially released on March 9, 2026, in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump issue 15. This power-up was tremendous and scaled Franky to a similar level to that of Jinbe, one of the Warlords of the Sea.
"This is Super Vega Cola! Your innards are immaculately designed, just as advanced as a Pacifista. Which is why I was stunned to learn that you only use cola to power yourself!! You see, Franky, fuel is passion!! Use this new stuff, and your raw power will explode!!!" — Vegapunk Lilith gives new power up to Franky, One Piece Chapter #1176
Meanwhile, One Piece chapter 1178, officially released on March 30, 2026, gave Chopper, the Doctor of the Straw Hat Pirates, the ability to counter Domi Reversi, suggesting an awakened Devil Fruit ability . Usopp, another member of the Straw Hat Pirates, received an upgrade to his Observation Haki, although it was very subtly put in place by Eiichiro Oda.
Then come the bigger power-ups, which belonged to the Wings of the Pirate King. In One Piece chapter 1194, Roronoa Zoro awakened and fully mastered the Color of the Supreme King , coating all his blades in it and putting the fear of God in Saint Sommers of the Holy Knights. In One Piece chapter 1197, Sanji's Conqueror's Haki is shining against Saint Killingham of the Holy Knights, making this arc the most significant when it comes to the Straw Hat power-ups.
"I won't take a single hit from you any longer. I don't care if you're a Celestial Dragon or whatever. You're standing there talking down to me in front of the people who took us in. You're getting on my nerves. Your head is too high. I said, bow down, horse-man!" — Sanji's nature shifts, One Piece Chapter #1196
With so many power-ups, especially for the Wings of the Pirate King, it is only natural for the captain of the crew, Luffy, to receive a power-up of his own. Traditionally, Luffy has always grown alongside his wings, and that is precisely why a power-up for him is practically confirmed at this point in the story already, as he engages in combat against Nerona Imu once again in the Underworld of Elbaf.
Why Luffy's New Upgrade in Elbaf Is Guaranteed
Luffy always grows in strength alongside his two wings, Zoro and Sanji. The very first power-up that Luffy received in One Piece came in the Enies Lobby arc. As we all remember, Zoro gained the power-up of Asura in Enies Lobby, while Sanji awakened Diable Jambe to take care of Jabra. In this arc, Luffy awakened Gear 2 and Gear 3 in response.
The Straw Hats did not receive any significant power-ups until the timeskip of the story, where, once again, Luffy progressed side by side with his two Wings. Both Zoro and Sanji received two forms of Haki each during the timeskip, while Luffy came out with all three forms of Haki after his training with Silvers Rayleigh. Then, in the Wano Country arc, Zoro received the power-up of Enma, which subconsciously brought out his Conqueror's Haki in Chapter 1033, on November 29, 2021. Meanwhile, in Chapter 1034, which was released on December 6, 2021, Sanji awakened the power of Ifrit Jambe, and in line with these two upgrades, Luffy received the power of Gear 5 in One Piece Chapter 1044, which was released on March 28, 2022, in Weekly Shonen Jump Issue 17.
"Possessing a body with the powers of rubber, and fighting in whatever way he fancies, bringing smiles to the faces of people, the Warrior of Liberation...also known as the Sun God, Nika!" — Elders explain Nika, One Piece Chapter #1044
Clearly, these three have always grown in strength together, and as such, it only makes sense for Luffy to gain an upgrade of his own after both Zoro and Sanji went on to master the Color of the Supreme King in Elbaf. The best upgrade that Luffy can get right now is Gear 6 . While Zoro and Sanji have received a boost to their Conqueror's Haki, it must be remembered that this type of Haki cannot be improved by training. Conqueror's Haki is inherently tied to the spirit of the user and to their overall physical capabilities. The only way to grow Conqueror's Haki is for the user to grow stronger. In other words, Luffy cannot receive a Conqueror's Haki power-up in Elbaf until he grows stronger, which can only be achieved using a new transformation.
"Of course I know that thou art not Joy Boy! Joy Boy was not this weak!!" — Imu mocks Luffy, One Piece Chapter #1188
Interestingly enough, Luffy's Devil Fruit capabilities are far inferior to those of Nerona Imu's Akuma no Mi. Imu also has a ring of black flames behind his head, while Luffy, despite being the Sun God, has no affiliation to the sun at all. It is entirely possible that Luffy will finally awaken the true potential of the Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika, and take his Gear 5 to a completely new level, labeling it Gear 6.

Luffy's Gear 6 Is Needed To Push Back Imu
As things stand, Luffy's Gear 5 has already lost the battle against Nerona Imu on two occasions . In One Piece chapter 1188, Luffy faced death against Imu, and had it not been for Scopper Gaban, he would have already perished. In One Piece chapter 1193, Luffy once again lost to Imu, and had it not been for Loki holding back the King of the World, he would have died once again. Clearly, Luffy's Gear 5 cannot beat Nerona Imu, as things are. This means the time for Gear 6 is finally here. In one way or another, Luffy needs to take his Devil Fruit awakening to a completely new level, granting him access to a new form known as Gear 6.
Interestingly enough, Nerona Imu has multiple awakened forms, as we have seen in Elbaf already. Similarly, there is no reason to doubt that Luffy can have multiple forms as well. By awakening a new level of Gear 5, Luffy can essentially improve his Color of the Supreme King as well, because this power is inherently tied to the overall power level of the user. This will automatically give Luffy a boost to Conqueror's Haki as well, but most importantly, allow him to finally defeat Nerona Imu.
All the latest manga chapters of One Piece by Eiichiro Oda, published in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump, are available to read via Manga Plus and Viz Media .
